hostname edge-services
object service WEB-HTTPS
 service tcp destination eq https
object service CLIENT-RANGE
 service tcp source range 49152 65535 destination eq 8443
object-group service WEB-PORTS tcp-udp
 port-object eq domain
object-group service NESTED-WEB tcp-udp
 group-object WEB-PORTS
object-group service WEB-APPS
 service-object tcp destination eq https
 service-object object WEB-HTTPS
object-group service APP-MIXED
 service-object object CLIENT-RANGE
 service-object tcp destination eq 2222
access-list SERVICE-IN extended permit object-group WEB-APPS 192.0.2.0 255.255.255.0 object-group SERVERS
access-list SERVICE-IN extended permit object-group NESTED-WEB any any
access-list SERVICE-IN extended permit object-group APP-MIXED any any
access-list SERVICE-IN extended deny tcp any any eq 22
access-list SERVICE-IN extended permit tcp any any eq 443
object-group network SERVERS
 network-object host 10.20.4.15
 network-object host 10.20.4.16
access-group SERVICE-IN in interface outside
username admin password 0 "ASA_SERVICE_CANARY"
